speaker: bartholomew_hathaway
text: You are late for a sickle and early for a speech. Bind.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: From six till four. I was sent as a back, not as a sentence.

speaker: bartholomew_hathaway
text: Short in the ear. The stooks stand with ground between them. That is this field.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I'll bind. I will not count your crop for you.

speaker: bartholomew_hathaway
text: Bind what is cut. Dinner is an hour, and I will say when the hour is.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Call it, and I will stop. Until you call it, I am binding.
